description: confirm dsns-94j's PATCH actually cascaded: udu's own per-DSN ego.dsn.admin record (granted at dsns-94e) was deleted along with everyone else's. Re-restricting at dsns-94k does not restore it -- if udu could still PATCH here, the cascade would have silently missed the very grant that authorized dsns-94j's own request. GET /@permissions with the admin token (not shown here) already confirmed 'items' comes back null; this proves the same thing from the affected user's own point of view instead of by inspecting server-side storage shape
